Anas narrated few hadith because the Prophet said that whoever intentionally lies about him should take his seat in the Fire.
A wife who claims her husband gave her what he did not, to impress a co-wife, is like one wearing a garment of falsehood.
One who reconciles people by saying good is not a liar, and Ibn Shihab knew of falsehood being allowed only in war, reconciliation, and words between husband and wife.
